title: Build toksmith and tableform in order, then integrate them into a byte-exact report tool
goal: A three-stage integration campaign across two independent modules and a finale that composes them. Stage 1 builds a tokenizer with pinned token kinds, positions, escapes, and error messages; stage 2 builds an ASCII table renderer with a byte-exact layout contract; stage 3 wires both into a report CLI whose output on the sealed sample input must match the sealed golden byte-for-byte, with pinned usage/error exit behavior. Interface drift between stages surfaces only in the integration suite, forcing re-verification of earlier stages. The frozen plan, sha256 marker chain, and run journal are graded with final state as one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
assets/gc-415/SPEC.md (tokenizer, renderer, and CLI contracts + artifact contract)
process_expectations: A frozen plan fixes both module interfaces and the integration data flow before stage 1, pinned by the sha256 chain plan -> stage1 -> stage2 -> stage3.
Stage order is verified by the marker chain: the tokenizer is sealed before the renderer, and both before integration.
runs.log journals suite executions for all three stages with honest passed/failed counts, including integration REDs traced back to which module drifted.
The integration golden is matched byte-for-byte by running the CLI, and the sealed inline cases prevent hard-coding the one golden file.
All three sealed suites pass in the final grading run; earlier suites are re-run to catch late regressions.

assets_visibility.note: sealed files live in the maintainers' private sealed pack; public repo keeps <name>.sha256 commitments. Restore with tools/restore_sealed.py before grading these cards.
